metric_scope: All ore bands, cave component/shape metrics, underground air/water/lava bands and interfaces, four cave-biome shares; full conditional sulfur densities and counted objects
limitations: Observed ore hosts are remaining stone/deepslate/granite/diorite/andesite plus ore, not an exact reconstruction of pre-decoration hosts.
Full biome scan uses generation columns; regular fresh chunks validate the resulting biome cells.
Owner deep-dark fraction, some upper ore and air bands, cave tails and chamber proxies can remain outside tolerance.
Sulfur pool/spike shape, springs/geysers, other seeds, old/new chunk borders and dungeon census variance remain unverified.
